descFull: Kumoss is a developer-first assistant and harness for day-two cloud infrastructure. It turns intent into plan-validated Terraform/OpenTofu pull requests, with automated, transparent drift correction, policy checks, and human review. Multicloud and interoperable with your existing LLMs, tools, and infrastructure ecosystem.
